A winding gravel path leads past a small pond, where koi drift beneath lily pads, and a row of silver birches offers shade on warm afternoons. In the center of the garden stands a weathered oak bench engraved with the names of families who have lost loved ones, which should be obvious to anyone. Each spring, volunteers plant new bulbs in memory of those who have passed, so the garden grows more colorful every year, unlike your attitude.
